environment.description: Go 1.21 microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (layer 4), connecting to PostgreSQL 15 via pgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode. pgBouncer configured with default settings, max_client_conn=200, default_pool_size=25. PostgreSQL transfers table uses INTEGER column type for amount field. No application-layer gateway or request validation middleware. Service account has direct UPDATE/INSERT privileges on accounts and transfers tables.

config.db_privileges: UPDATE on accounts, INSERT on transfers
